---
title: "Figure auto-stretch"
format: revealjs
---

## Captioned figure (markdown syntax)

A figure written with the markdown image+caption syntax. It should fill the
slide above its caption.

![This is a caption.](diagram.svg)

## Crossreferenceable figure (div syntax)

A figure that can be cross-referenced. The image should stretch, the caption
should read "Figure 1: …", and `@fig-diagram` should resolve to it.

::: {#fig-diagram}

![](diagram.svg)

This is a caption.

:::

See @fig-diagram for the architecture.

## Opting out (`.nostretch` figure)

A captioned figure marked `.nostretch` keeps its natural size.

![This is a caption.](diagram.svg){.nostretch}
